title: 第504章 战场第503章 骸骨高地
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 幽火骑士是一种，在骸骨高地非常常见的亡灵。
在商路上，除了它，冒险者们还提到过幽火战马、骸骨巨犬，以及那些摇摇晃晃的骷髅哨兵。
这些东西都长着一副吓人的模样。
身形高大，眼眶里冒着幽蓝的火光。
但实际上实力非常弱小。
比起禁地里那些真正的狠角色，完全不是一个量级。
它们的存在，更像是这片高地的背景板，吓唬吓唬不了解情况的过路人。
在接下来的几天里，林鬼和艾尔维亚陆续见到了这些亡灵生物。
每个夜晚，当他们升起篝火休息的时候。
那些东西就会从黑暗中浮现出来。
它们聚集在篝火照不到的边缘地带，沉默地凝视着他们。
不靠近，不攻击，只是看着。
就和第一夜，那只幽火骑士一样。
默默地看着他们。
偶尔有几只体型稍大的徘徊得近一些。
但始终保持在火光边缘，像是被一道无形的界限挡住了。
这诡异的现象，就连艾尔维亚都察觉到不对。
收起了最初的轻视。
她开始主动往林鬼身边靠，睡觉都是靠着林鬼的肩膀浅睡。
而手掌的默默捏紧的剑，从未离身。
白日，是行进的最好时候。
阳光的照射，会让亡灵生物行动迟缓。
大部分强大危险的亡灵生物都不会在白日，出现。
而夜晚，则是亡灵生物狂躁的时候。
这些黑暗生物，在黑夜庇护会变得更加强大，活跃，嗜血。
但......每次夜晚的休整，围在艾尔维亚和林鬼周围的亡灵生物。
除了最初的骷髅猫，林鬼看不到狂躁、嗜血的迹象。
甚至，林鬼从他们身上感受到了，“人”的踪影。
仿佛是一群活着的亡灵，在盯着他这个外来的法师。
这种情况，他从未在那些走商的冒险者，口中听到过。
这份诡异压在林鬼的心里，让他下意识加快了行进的速度。
随着他们深入骸骨高地，周围的景象也在变化。
散落的碎骨越来越多，同时出现了完整的、庞大的骸骨。
那些巨大的骨架，横卧在灰白色的荒芜土地上。
content_en:
The Ghostfire Knight is a kind of undead that is very common in the Bone Highlands.
On the trade route, in addition to it, adventurers also mentioned the Ghostfire War Horse, the Giant Skeleton Dog, and those rickety skeleton sentinels.
These things all look scary.
He was tall and tall, with blue fire in his eyes.
But in fact the strength is very weak.
Compared to the real ruthless characters in the forbidden area, it is not at the same level.
Their existence is more like the background of this highland, scaring and frightening passers-by who don't understand the situation.
In the next few days, Lin Gui and Elvia saw these undead creatures one after another.
Every night, when they light up the bonfire to rest.
Those things will emerge from the darkness.
They gathered on the edge beyond the reach of the campfire and stared at them in silence.
Not approaching, not attacking, just watching.
Just like the Ghostfire Knight on the first night.
Watch them silently.
Occasionally a few larger ones wander closer.
But he always stayed at the edge of the fire, as if blocked by an invisible boundary.
Even Elvia noticed something was wrong with this strange phenomenon.
Put away the initial contempt.
She began to take the initiative to lean against Lin Gui, sleeping lightly on Lin Gui's shoulder.
And the sword silently clenched in the palm of his hand never left his body.
Daytime is the best time to travel.
Sunlight will make undead creatures move slowly.
Most powerful and dangerous undead creatures will not appear during the day.
And night is when the undead creatures become manic.
These dark creatures will become more powerful, active, and bloodthirsty when sheltered in the dark night.
But...every night, undead creatures surround Elvia and the Lin Kuei.
Except for the original skeleton cat, there are no signs of mania or bloodthirst in the forest ghosts.
Lin Gui even sensed traces of "people" from them.
It was as if a group of living undead were staring at this foreign mage.
He had never heard of this situation from the adventurers who were doing business.
This strangeness pressed into Lin Gui's heart, causing him to subconsciously speed up his movement.
As they penetrated deeper into the Bone Plateau, the surrounding scenery also changed.
More and more broken bones were scattered, and complete and huge skeletons appeared at the same time.
Those huge skeletons lie on the gray and white barren land.
